system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

You can spend 2 Superiority Die when you begin to move, increasing your speed by 20 feet. If you score a hit with an attack against a creature adjacent to you when you end your movement, then all members of your Squad can spend their reaction to move up to their full movement and make an attack or cast a Jutsu of C-Rank or lower targeting the same creature, adding your spent Superiority Die to their damage dealt.
